title: 个人资料入口图标
intendedUse: 游戏大厅的个人资料按钮，不包含姓名或用户信息
prompt: Create a transparent-background polished stylized 3D casual-game icon: one friendly ivory bust silhouette inside a rounded deep-teal medallion with a small restrained warm-gold rim. Match the supplied reference's dimensional enamel finish, rounded bevels, controlled highlights, and soft upper-left lighting. Keep one simple centered silhouette with transparent padding, readable at 64 px; do not copy the reference's cards or exact medallion silhouette.
negativePrompt: realistic portrait, photorealism, flat vector, detailed facial features, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, clutter

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Rendering material, teal/ivory/gold palette, bevel highlights and lighting only.
